page.layout: One page of text, one column. Running head at top with page number at top left. Running text in paragraphs, an italic verse quotation set between them, then a centred title, a "QVÆSTIO" heading, and an italic question running to the foot of the page. No margin notes, no catchword, no signature.

main_text.p: Papistis videtur maior: Quare?quia cæci.De re igitur disputamus: non de opinionibus hominum.

Denique sentire & dicere, authoritatem Ecclesiæ, maiorem esse authoritate Scripturæ, quæ est verbum Dei: nil aliud est, quàm dicere, homines esse supra Deum. Quanta autem hæc sit blasphemia, quisque cogitet. Declarant hac doctrina Papistæ, se veros esse Antichristos. Antichristi enim proprium est, ut sese efferat supra omne, quod dicitur Deus, ut ait Paulus 2. Thess.2. Et nunc editis etiam carminibus impudenter hoc de Papa prædicant eum esse tanquam Deum, nec Pa-pa damnat. Est enim impressa Romæ imago huius Antichristi, ubi oracula, quæ de Deo, & de Messia Christo sunt apud Prophetas, Papæ attribuuntur: & deinde præter alia sunt ibi hi versus:

p.i: Angelicum soluit nomen, pium ipse Michaël: Nam tanquam Deus est, qui ante Mi-chaël erat.

page.notes: Printed "Quare?quia" and "cæci.De" run together without a space, copied as printed. The question heading is set in italic, and the first word "Utrum" was printed "Vtrum", corrected to u per the spelling rule. The verse is set in italic and its last line breaks at "Mi-chaël", with the printed hyphen kept. The decorative initials "N" of "Nam" and the ornament before "An" are not transcribed as letters. Long s is written as plain s throughout, e.g. "impressa" (printed "impresla").
